lines.text: Why does tomorrow-you get all the hard work?
Office workers picked a snack to get a week later: fruit, or chocolate and chips.
When the day came, they could choose again.
Across two hundred workers, far more grabbed the junk food in the moment than had planned to.
Future-you is always healthier, on paper.
So decide now, then make switching hard.

post.title: Why Future You Always Gets the Hard Work #shorts
post.description: We plan like saints and choose like snackers. In Read & van Leeuwen (1998), 200 office workers chose far more unhealthy snacks when picking for right now than when picking a week ahead. That's present bias. #psychology #habits #selfcontrol
